user.title: AR Media Bridge
user.description: Enter the IP address shown in the AR Media Bridge app on the box.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: A 6-digit code is now showing on the TV (it's also on the AR Media Bridge app screen). Enter it below.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the box. Check it's on and the AR Media Bridge app has notification access.
error.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the TV and try again.
error.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute - a new code will be shown.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.
abort.no_device_id: The box didn't identify itself. Update the AR Media Bridge app.

init.title: What happens when {name} plays or pauses
init.description: Pick lights, scenes, scripts or switches for each state. Lights are set to the brightness under them (0% turns them off). Scenes, scripts and switches are turned on. Leave a box empty to do nothing for that state.

data.idle_targets: When stopped (back to home screen / app closed)

data_description.delay: The state has to hold this long first, so skipping ahead or a quick buffer doesn't flicker the lights.
data_description.dark_only: Uses the sun integration. Does nothing during the day.
